note:
Core reaches zero: 348 -> 0. Five functions were over the 90-line budget and none of them was one operation.

    189  upgrade_code/18.3-00-l10n-fiscal-position-taxes.py  upgrade
    171  addons/test_performance_compare/compare.py          main
    152  logutils.py                                         init_logger
    149  upgrade_code/18.2-00-l10n-translate.py              upgrade
    137  upgrade_code/18.5-00-no-tax-tag-invert.py           upgrade

Each split follows a seam the function already had, so no logic moved:

  `init_logger` was four phases behind one name -- install the record factory,
  silence the dependency warnings, install the handler, apply the configured
  levels. `_install_log_handler` returns False for the `log_config` file that
  asks not to keep the Odoo default, which is what the early `return` in the
  middle of the old body meant; the caller reads that as its own return.

  `compare.py::main` was argument parsing, a header, a table, a summary, a
  divergence report and an exclusives report printed one after the other, each
  in two spellings (`--md` and fixed-width). Split along those six. Verified by
  diffing both modes against the pre-split file over a synthetic pair of
  reports: byte-identical output, both modes.

  The three upgrade scripts are each two passes over the file manager -- harvest
  into a dict, then rewrite using it -- with the per-file work inline. Each pass
  is now a named function taking one file, and `upgrade` is the two loops.
  `18.5` also gained `report_sign_conflicts` and `formula_only_diff`, which were
  a dict comprehension and an ndiff filter written out longhand.

`pyfunclen` ratchets EXCESS LINES over the budget, not offenders, so splitting a
function raises the function count while lowering the number: the tree now has
25 more functions than it did and 348 fewer excess lines. Nothing in the budget
moved -- MAX_LINES is still 90.

The floor is re-derived at a commit in HEAD history. The previous one was banked
at a commit this branch no longer has (ORPHANED-BASE), so it could not be
reproduced; 348 is what the tree measured immediately before this change.
